editorial:
Imagine a world where people actually eat zombies for dinner. That is the wild setup you get here. You follow three selfish millennials who head to a zombie farm, only to get stuck inside with a grumpy, old-school boss who can barely use a computer. The vibe is a mix of a goofy comedy and a scary survival movie. It focuses on the clash between the young kids who live on their phones and the older guy who does things the hard way. It is a weird, colorful ride that does not take itself too seriously, making it a great pick for a movie night with friends.

The action is fast and the animation style gives it a unique look that keeps you interested. You will love how the tension builds as the zombies break loose, though some of the jokes might feel a bit hit-or-miss. If you enjoy stories where unlikely people have to work together to stay alive, you should definitely give this a go.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with the group finally putting aside their differences to fight off the zombie horde. After a chaotic battle, the millennials learn to respect the older supervisor's grit. They manage to escape the farm just in time, but the twist shows that the appetite for zombie meat is still huge in society. They survive the nightmare, but they are changed by the experience and the scary reality of their world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird horror comedies and unique animation.
